attackers_goals: Create a backdoor account for later access to Azure AD or Azure resources, or delete evidence of such an account.
description: An Azure AD account creation was performed by a user that doesn't typically create users.
investigative_actions: Follow further actions by the initiator. Check for new resource creations by the new user. Check if the new user was added to a privileged role. Follow further actions done by the new user.
name: Azure account creation by a non-standard account
